name: Tribhuvan University
description: Nepal's largest and oldest university, enrolling over 400,000 students across 60+ constituent and 1,000+ affiliated colleges nationwide. Known for BSc CSIT, BBA, MBBS, engineering and humanities programs.

name: Kathmandu University
description: Nepal's first autonomous, private, non-profit university. Renowned for engineering (BE), medicine (MBBS), management (BBA) and science research with semester-based modern curricula.

name: Pokhara University
description: A semester-based autonomous university known for quality management, health sciences and engineering programs with a strong focus on practical education in the beautiful Lakeside city.

name: Purbanchal University
description: Eastern Nepal's premier university covering engineering, management, education, health and humanities across Morang, Sunsari and beyond.

name: Gandaki University
description: A young, technology-focused university with modern programs in engineering, science, management and health built around applied research.

name: Mid-Western University
description: The hub of higher education in Karnali province, offering programs across education, management, science, engineering and health.

name: Far-Western University
description: Serving the Sudurpashchim region with programs in education, management, science, engineering and medical sciences.

name: Nepal Sanskrit University
description: The national centre for Sanskrit, Vedic and traditional knowledge, also offering modern humanities and education programs.

name: Lumbini Buddhist University
description: The first Buddhist university in Nepal, blending Buddhist studies, culture, tourism and modern liberal arts education.

name: Agriculture & Forestry University
description: Nepal's dedicated university for agriculture, forestry, animal science and veterinary medicine located in the heart of the Terai.

name: Nepal Open University
description: Nepal's first open and distance learning university offering flexible online programs for working professionals.

name: Karnali Academy of Health Sciences
description: A health-sciences academy focused on medical and nursing education tailored to the remote Karnali region.
